protocol.counterbalancing: Presentation remains AB within each repetition; temperature conditions are separate.
protocol.eligibility: Complete pair metadata; repetitions share one immutable repetition-group key.
protocol.failure_handling: Retries increment retry_count, never repetition_index; failures remain operational outcomes.
protocol.hypothesis: Repeated identical pair/configuration evaluations quantify decision consistency.
protocol.interpretation_limit: Only same-unit repetitions support stochastic-consistency claims.
protocol.primary_metric: Within-group consistency rate and disagreement rate.
protocol.research_question: Does the same judge make the same decision when the same evaluation is repeated?
protocol.tie_handling: TIE is a valid repeated outcome.
protocol.unit_definition: Exact dataset/prompt/pair/judge/provider/template/temperature/top-p/seed-policy/condition group, with explicit repetition index.
